An '''attack armor company''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
The company was comprised of three [[armor platoon]]s, and a [[heavy weapons repulsorlift platoon]], along with command and support elements. Companies equipped with heavy tanks numbered two hundred men, sixteen tanks, and nine heavy weapons repulsorlift vehicles. Companies outfitted with light tanks had two hundred and thirty two men, twenty-eight tanks, and nine repulsorlifts. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] commanded the company from a modified heavy tank.<ref name="ISB" />

An attack armor company could be augmented by the addition of two [[repulsorlift platoon]]s, an [[armor platoon]], and a [[line platoon]].<ref name="ISB2" />
